items.title: Defence production soars to a record Rs 1.78 lakh crore in Financial Year 2025-26
items.snippet: Press Release Page | Press Information Bureau Ministry of Defence Defence production soars to a record Rs 1.78 lakh crore in Financial Year 2025-26 प्रविष्टि तिथि: 17 JUN 2026 9:17AM by PIB Delhi India’s annual defence production has surged to an all-time high of Rs 1.78 lakh crore in the Financial Year (FY) 2025-26. The milestone represents a 15.6% growth over the previous fiscal year’s output of Rs 1.54 lakh crore …
